description: For a model ALREADY on Amazon as a model with variations (published with publish_amazon_variation_family): what its parent listing shows now (currentTitle) and what the CRM would send — the model's Amazon title set with set_channel_texts (modelId), else the model's name translated into the marketplace's language (titleSource model or name) — with warnings when that name would go untranslated, and Amazon's own dry run: status ready (Amazon would take it), nothing (Amazon already shows the same, nothing to send) or rejected (issues in the marketplace's language). Changes nothing. Then send it with update_amazon_variation_parent.

modelId.description: A product model id (the model a product's modelId points at; get_product shows it).

name: check_amazon_variation_parent
title: Check a model's parent on Amazon
